summary: Publish safe same-host handoff for idle task/workspace claims
description: Produce the next immutable Go Workflow Stack release containing the reviewed same-host idle task/workspace handoff and preserve the existing Dutch-router fix. The current remote latest tag is v0.3.46, so v0.3.47 is expected; the release tool must reserve the actual next patch version from live remote refs. Align runtime/package/self-pin/release-pairing metadata, run the exact candidate release preflight, then publish only to the configured official GitHub origin/main with explicit push policy. Preserve all historical tags and pairings; do not deploy, attach unrequested assets, or use GitHub Actions.
acceptance: The release controller reserves the next patch version from live remote refs under the official github-release profile; with v0.3.46 still latest, the expected candidate is v0.3.47 and no existing tag is replaced.
Version, runtime constant, stack self-pin, release pairing, changelog and release notes identify the exact same candidate; historical release mappings and v0.3.46 remain unchanged.

The exact candidate passes the full Python suite, make check, repo and architecture validation, WSL doctor, and release-check candidate preflight including its immutable template pairing; no development override or GitHub Actions is used.

After an independent final review, the existing release publisher commits/integrates, creates an annotated tag, pushes main and tag, publishes a GitHub release with no unrequested assets, and reads back exact remote refs and hosted release metadata.
No deployment or application service action occurs; release remains pending if any test, review, tag, remote, or hosted readback gate fails.
